host_result.review_note: 31 host CTest cases, seven renderer contracts and 10418 SRT JIT checks passed. The sparse production extractor still required SynchronizeDmaBuffers() after its callback was added. Native configure/build and both game launches were not reached.

root_cause: The production DMA interface changed to take on_read, but its existing extraction test and C++ fixture still expected the no-argument interface. The prior validation did not run this existing coupled fixture.
correction: Extract the unique SynchronizeDmaBuffers function independently of its parameter spelling.
Update the existing fixture declaration and callers to the actual callback interface.

Check that every synchronized chunk emits exactly one read callback after its upload, preserving the original buffer owner, byte offset and byte count. Existing sparse limits, aliases, BDA ownership and >4GiB chunk checks remain active.

validation.sparse_real_vulkan_headers_mode: PASS 288 ranges / 7 scenarios; no VkDevice or GPU work
negative_controls: Omitting the DMA read callback is rejected by the updated fixture.
Changing the DMA callback byte offset by one is rejected by the updated fixture.
remaining_runner_checks: PASS descriptor runtime layout pool sizing
PASS unexpected Vulkan error fails closed
PASS actual x86 guest-to-HLE stack alignment
